questions.prompt: Which city was destroyed by the Romans in 146 BC?
questions.fact: Both fell in the same year, one in Greece and one in North Africa, in unrelated campaigns.

questions.prompt: Which force causes a ball to slow as it rolls across grass?
questions.fact: On a perfectly frictionless surface it would roll forever, which is Newton's first law stated practically.

questions.prompt: Which sport features a term called the paddock?
questions.fact: In both it means the enclosure where competitors prepare before going out to compete.

questions.prompt: Which musician recorded the album Hounds of Love?
questions.fact: One of its songs returned to number one worldwide in 2022, thirty-seven years after release, after appearing in a series.

questions.prompt: Which is the highest mountain in the contiguous United States?
questions.fact: It sits roughly a hundred kilometres from the lowest point in North America, in Death Valley.

questions.prompt: Which term describes a novel published in instalments?
questions.fact: Dickens shaped whole plots around reader reaction between instalments, which is early audience-responsive storytelling.

questions.prompt: Which company created the Rust-adjacent language Zig?
questions.fact: It is developed by a non-profit funded by donations, with no corporate backer at all.
